scientific_integrity: All-size claims have an explicit proof. Finite direct bracket tests corroborate, not establish, generality. Earlier general centralizer and rank mechanisms are credited; distinctions between projective and elementwise graphs are explicit. Sriwongsa (2025), Theorem 2.12, already covers the abstract isolated-projective-point centralizer criterion; the asserted contribution is the complete nontrivial component classification and its graph-specific enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs without isolated vertices, independent edge labels, and finite fields; exact component structure and cardinalities, but not exact internal spectra or diameters; no priority or external validation claim.
title: Projective commuting components of graphical Lie algebras and the connected-domination enumerator
